hypothesis: Instruction count is explained by spatial work, temporal-volume work, bottleneck attention pairs, and the fixed overhead of processing a populated feature cache.

pcvs.name: spatial_sites
pcvs.rationale: Captures spatial convolution, padding, normalization, and cached-frame copying costs.

pcvs.name: input_sites
pcvs.rationale: Captures convolution and elementwise work that scales with the input chunk's temporal length.

pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Captures quadratic spatial attention work at the encoder bottleneck, which has one temporal frame in this workload.

pcvs.expression: int(feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None)
pcvs.name: warm_cache
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes initial chunks from subsequent chunks with cached concatenations and temporal downsampling.
